d:
Presenting the full video song "Dhan Te Nan" from the Bollywood movie 'Kaminey' featuring Shahid Kapoor, Priyanka Chopra. The song is sung by Sukhwinder Singh, Vishal Dadlani, Robert Bob Omulo and the music is composed by Vishal Bharadwaj. The lyrics are written by Gulzar.
Song : Dhan Te Nan
Movie : Kaminey
Singer : Sukhwinder Singh, Vishal Dadlani, Robert Bob Omulo
Star Cast : Shahid Kapoor, Priyanka Chopra, Deb Mukherjee, Rajatabha Dutta & Others
Music Director : Vishal Bharadwaj
Lyrics : Gulzar
Music Label : T-Series
